name: GPT-6 Astra
short: OpenAI's 1.05M-context Astra flagship for frontier reasoning and agents; FrontierMath 97.6%, GPQA 96%, gated Daybreak rollout as first Critical cyber tier.
standout: OpenAI’s reasoning ceiling for frontier math and long-context agents, with a first-of-its-kind critical-cyber tier.
tradeoff: Flagship positioning comes at flagship cost and behind a gated rollout — it is a specialist for high-stakes work, not an everyday default.
